title: Among clients who reside in districts within the 'east Bohemia' region and
question: Among clients who reside in districts within the 'east Bohemia' region and hold accounts opened in 1993 with weekly statement issuance ('POPLATEK TYDNE'), find the account that has an active loan (status 'C' or 'D') with duration over 12 months and the smallest approved loan amount. Return the account ID along with the salary gap (difference between the highest and lowest average salaries across all districts).

prediction.sql:
SELECT a.XCL_001,
       (SELECT MAX(XCL_027) - MIN(XCL_027) FROM district) AS salary_gap
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
JOIN disp dp ON dp.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
JOIN client c ON c.XCL_009 = dp.XCL_014
JOIN loan l ON l.XCL_034 = a.XCL_001
WHERE d.XCL_019 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND c.XCL_012 = d.XCL_017
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.XCL_004) = '1993'
  AND a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
  AND l.XCL_037 > 12
ORDER BY l.XCL_036 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT a.XCL_001,
       (SELECT MAX(XCL_027) - MIN(XCL_027) FROM district) AS salary_gap
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.XCL_002 = d.XCL_017
JOIN disp dp ON dp.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
JOIN client c ON c.XCL_009 = dp.XCL_014
JOIN loan l ON l.XCL_034 = a.XCL_001
WHERE d.XCL_019 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND c.XCL_012 = d.XCL_017
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.XCL_004) = '1993'
  AND a.XCL_003 = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
  AND l.XCL_037 > 12
ORDER BY l.XCL_036 ASC
LIMIT 1
